## The pass

Interrail Global Pass, 7 travel days within 1 month, youth (under 28, I just make it) second class. Paid €298 in the
spring sale. Pass number EIR7741Q, lives in the Rail Planner app. Activated on 2 September 2024. Flew Lisbon to
Barcelona separately since the Iberian connections are still a mess.

## Route

1. Barcelona Sants → Lyon Part-Dieu, TGV inOui 9702, 5h
2. Lyon → Geneva → Zürich, regional + IC, 5h30 with a cheese stop
3. Zürich HB → Wien Hbf, Nightjet NJ 467, overnight
4. Wien → Budapest Keleti, Railjet RJX 165, 2h40
5. Budapest → Ljubljana, 8h40, the slow beautiful one
6. Ljubljana → Trieste via Sežana bus-rail combo
7. Trieste → Venezia S. Lucia, regional, then flew home from VCE

## Reservations, the hidden cost

- TGV Barcelona to Lyon: €35, pass-holder quota sold out on the website, got it at the Sants counter
- Nightjet couchette, 6-berth: €39
- Everything else: no reservation needed
- Total extra: €74

## Night train log

NJ 467 left Zürich at 21:40 and rolled into Wien Hbf at 07:49. Couchette berth 54, top bunk. Shared with a Dutch
couple and a man called Pieter who snored like a leaf blower. Breakfast was two rolls, butter, jam, and coffee in a
paper cup. Vienna itself is written up in [[Reise nach Wien]].

## Rules I learned the hard way

- A travel day runs midnight to midnight, so the 23:10 regional from Lyon would have burned two days
- On a night train only the departure day counts, as long as you don't change trains after midnight
- Add each journey in the app before boarding; one conductor in Slovenia was very unimpressed with me
- Swiss panoramic lines want a supplement even with the pass

## Was it worth it

Point-to-point tickets for the same route came to roughly €410. So the pass plus reservations saved around €40,
which is not much. The real win was flexibility: I stayed an extra night in Ljubljana on a whim.

## Language moments

Ordering in Italian on the Trieste platform went sideways, see [[Italian false friends]]. German in Zürich and Vienna
was where [[German cases cheat sheet]] finally paid off. Everything fit in the bag from [[Packing list carry-on]].
